integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible checks are included; finite stochastic checks corroborate but do not prove infinite parameter claims; independent scientific validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only variance of harmonic contribution beta X^2/2 is optimized, not the full logarithmic-harmonic potential, dissipation, or thermodynamic reset cost.
The reset rate is fixed and positive; reset positions are iid, independent of motion, positive, and have finite fourth moment.
The process uses the canonical nonnegative squared-CIR extension at an accessible origin.
Literature searches are not a proof that no equivalent optimization exists.
title: Sharp reset-law optimization of harmonic-energy fluctuations in a logarithmic-harmonic diffusion
